thread:
Maya (CS): heads up — Velonix (trial, onboarding day 3) is seeing repeated 429s from our sdkgateway when they spin up multiple worker processes. CSM flagged this as a renewal risk if we can’t stabilize today. 

Alex (SE): can you paste a sample request/headers and approximate fanout rate? are these 429s during preflight / handshake or actual generate calls?

Maya (CS): mainly during initial handshake / probe requests as their fleet starts. They reported ~40 concurrent preflight checks per second from a small set of hosts. Example header they sent: `Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral>` and `x-client-id: velonix-staging`.

Jorge (SRE): I pulled edge logs for their tenant id — I see the token refresh pattern: short-lived ephemeral tokens + tight retry loops. Looks like many requests hit the /v1/sdkgateway/preflight endpoint. Rate limiter returned 429 with `X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0`.

Alex (SE): that matches a classic thundering-probe. Two immediate mitigations: 1) instruct client to add jitter/backoff and coalesce preflight requests; 2) temporarily raise their per-tenant preflight window while we dig. I can craft a small client snippet to coalesce in the SDK.

Nina (Support): Velonix is in trial and their onboarding bar is at 60%. They want a live pairing session at 10:30 PT. If we can reduce errors they’ll move to prod.

Jorge (SRE): I can lift the preflight quota for their account for 2 hours. I’ll also add short-lived logging to trace one of their IPs. Which IPs should I whitelist?

Maya (CS): they listed two hosts: 54.23.11.9 and 54.23.11.10. Please whitelist those and keep the temporary quota bump.

Alex (SE): adding an SDK-side debounce is quick. Suggested pseudo-code for coalescing (send at most one preflight per 200ms per process, aggregate promises):
```
let inflight = null
function preflight() {
  if (inflight) return inflight
  inflight = fetch('/v1/sdkgateway/preflight', { headers })
    .finally(() => { inflight = null })
  return inflight
}
```
This cuts fanout a lot for multi-worker setups.

Maya (CS): can we also confirm token TTL tolerance? They rotate ephemerals every 30s which seems aggressive.

Jorge (SRE): our token validation accepts up to 2s skew by default. We can temporarily accept older tokens by +15s tolerance for this tenant while they adjust. I’ll do that and revert after the call.

Sam (PM): small ops question — do we have a product knob to auto-detect probe storms and automatically engage a fallback policy? If not, we should log this as a feature (low effort) — auto-coalesce preflight traffic per client-id.

Alex (SE): no automated knob today; we rely on rate limiting + docs. Quick follow-ups: 1) Can Velonix add client jitter? 2) Can SRE bump the tenant window for the pairing? 3) Support to run the call and gather SDK logs?

Nina (Support): I’ll schedule the 10:30 PT session and ask them to enable verbose SDK logs. Also sending a short doc with recommended client settings: `preflight_coalesce_ms=200`, `token_refresh_grace=15s`, `max_retries=3` with exponential backoff.

Maya (CS): deploy-bot just reported a small config change applied: `preflight_quota_bump: velonix -> +5r/s for 2h` — thanks Jorge :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: config-change velonix preflight_quota updated by jorge (SRE) at 4829001500

Alex (SE): I'll push a small SDK patch to the trial branch with the debounce helper and a short README snippet recommending the settings. Patch ETA 90m.

Jorge (SRE): added temporary token skew tolerance and IP whitelist. Monitoring now — I see error rate drop starting. Sample log snippet:
```
[4829002001] tenant=velonix status=200 route=/v1/sdkgateway/preflight src=54.23.11.9 latency=78ms
[4829002010] tenant=velonix status=429 route=/v1/sdkgateway/preflight src=54.23.11.10 latency=12ms remaining=0
```
We want remaining >0, but with coalesce + bump we'll get there.

Maya (CS): great — we’ll run the session, collect SDK logs, and if the SDK patch stabilizes we'll keep Velonix on their trial path. CSM notes: reduce churn in first-week onboarding to lower renewal risk.

Sam (PM): filing FR: automatic preflight coalescing + tenant-proactive-safety (small feature doc). Tagging as P1 for Q2 backlog if this repeats.

Nina (Support): post-call action items I’ll send: logs, SDK patch link, and a recap for Velonix.

Alex (SE): one more quick tip to share with Velonix engineers: prefer reusing a single persistent preflight promise across worker forks or use a centralized coordinator — avoids stampeding.

Maya (CS): thanks all. I’ll update the customer and close the loop after the 10:30. If anyone wants to join the pairing ping me. :pray:
